event.description: Tie the two MQA ff17 blocks
event.proposal: family: parameter tying; retained incumbent is 3584 parameters at 99.1700%, a +0.17 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none; same-family failed result: attempt-0001, shared standard-attention d16/h2/L2 ff48 at 3456 parameters and 75.95% validation after 30000 steps; prior attempts in this family: 1. The current incumbent differs materially through reversed operands, MQA, and ff17, all of which changed the attention/capacity regime. Hypothesis: reuse one MQA+ff17 block for both sequential depth applications, preserving two causal self-attention passes while removing one block's parameters and yielding 2208 total parameters. This is more informative than deleting a layer because it tests whether repeated computation in the successful MQA regime can substitute for independently parameterized depth. Keep the mixed-digit training curriculum and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3584 parameters.
